basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: Binds a feature of interest, observed property, procedure, result value and unit for one observation act.
Unlike the sensor asset or calibration record, it references them.
Unlike a sample record, it describes the measurement, not the material.
Corrections are additive; prior values are retained.

may: Register an observation with measurand, unit and time.
Supersede an observation while retaining the old value.
mustNot: Publish a value without unit, measurand or time.
Compute quality evaluation as if it were the external service.
requiresHuman: Accepting corrections to values used in regulatory or clinical decisions.

considerations: Measurements of people can be health or personal data.
Wrong measurements can lead to unsafe decisions.

items: An observation has a feature of interest, an observed property, a procedure, a result with unit and a phenomenon time.
Often confused with a sensor, a sample, a calibration certificate and a derived statistic.
Unsafe decisions from values without uncertainty or unit.

properties.reason: An observation record holds measured values as data; the observed object carries the physical properties.
